title: Admin Logging & Offline Diagnostics
changes: Added real-time application logs in the Admin area to diagnose connectivity and system issues without opening the browser console.
Offline detection now pings an external service (Cloudflare) to verify actual internet connectivity instead of relying solely on Cloudflare's less-reliable browser flag.
Logs show timestamps, verification attempts, and the final online/offline determination, making it easy to see if connection detection is working correctly.
Settings is organized into tabs — Learning, Character, Account, Data & Offline, and About — with tab choice remembered between visits.
Fixed offline packs to include all core data (vocabulary, kana, manga, conversations, theatre, grammar, mnemonics) so the app can boot completely offline.
